title: Escapetown Bloomington
specs: Suitable for kids, teens, adults, and mixed-age families
Indoor activity, good for all weather
Kids 6 and under are free; kids 7 and older considered students
Children must be accompanied by at least one adult
Some rooms require minimum of 4 players (Monkey Business and Mystery at Skull Cabin)
Book with as few as two people; larger groups can split into multiple rooms
blurb: Guests participate in private escape room experiences where they solve puzzles and use teamwork to escape within a 60-minute time limit. Rooms are designed for mixed-age groups and are suitable for families, birthday parties, and other celebrations. The facility is accessed by walking up one flight of stairs.
extraNote: Reservations required at least 90 minutes in advance · If booking within 90 minutes, call to discuss options · If room is full online, call to add more people while keeping room private · Generally no group discounts; contact to request exceptions
